_comment: English for every localized data field, keyed by the Russian text. Applied by scripts/pipeline/add-english.mjs to data/*.json and data/**/*.geojson. Place names follow the romanisation used in English-language literature on the Caspian.
Горизонтальное отступание = падение уров: Horizontal retreat = drop in level ÷ seabed slope. The slope is set per sector from the published literature on Caspian bathymetry; the line is shifted along the inward normal. This is a model, not a satellite observation.
Спутниковые источники (JRC GSW, Sentinel: Satellite sources (JRC GSW, Sentinel-5P, Sentinel-1, FIRMS, ERA5) cover the whole sea evenly and depend on no country's permission — they are what closes this gap.
Координаты сверены с Global Energy Monit: Coordinates were cross-checked against Global Energy Monitor, WRI and OpenStreetMap. Records without a confirmed point are flagged approx and shown in the interface as approximate. `profile` is a descriptive weight by facility type, not a measured emissions composition.
Более 105 млн тонн токсичных отходов, из: Over 105 million tonnes of toxic waste, of which 52 million tonnes are low-level radioactive
Over 105 million tonnes of toxic waste, of which 52 million tonnes are low-level radioactive
5 км от Актау, 8 км от берега моря: 5 km from Aktau, 8 km from the sea shore
Главный риск — токсичная пыль с высохшей: The main risk is toxic dust blown off the dried surface
Исследование 2024 года: уровень загрязне: A 2024 study: contamination does not exceed the permissible limits, and biological remediation was chosen
Индекс чистоты — сводная модельная оценк: The purity index is this platform's composite model estimate, built from the share of oil products, the industrial load and satellite aerosol data. The formula is on the Methodology page.
Годовая модельная оценка избыточной смер: An annual model estimate of excess mortality associated with air pollution, following WHO methodology (PM2.5 concentration × exposure-response function × population). It is not a measurement and not a real-time counter.
Данные Ирана и Туркменистана фактически: Iranian and Turkmen figures are effectively closed — the estimates shown come from industry reviews and are less precise.
The portal was unreachable from the hackathon network. The series was reconstructed from published altimetry values and rates of decline (the anchor points are listed openly in scripts/pipeline/build-datasets.ts). When the portal is reachable, the series is replaced by the real file.
Профили Ирана (2008) и Туркменистана (20: The Iranian (2008) and Turkmen (2012) profiles are out of date.
Испарение — расчётная величина замыкания: Evaporation is a calculated closure term for the balance at the observed rate of decline, not a measurement.
Оценки численности расходятся в четыре р: Population estimates differ by a factor of four. The platform shows a range rather than a single number — that is the honest answer, and it reflects the real state of knowledge.
Официальная статистика вылова не отражае: Official catch statistics do not reflect reality: illegal (IUU) fishing is estimated at 4–10 times the legal catch. Modern stock assessment methods are not applied.
Сезонность построена по наблюдениям GBIF: Seasonality is derived from GBIF observations in the Caspian basin.
NDVI × 100 (средний по прибрежной полосе: NDVI × 100 (mean over the 20 km coastal strip)
Caspian Seals Research and Rehabilitatio: Caspian Seals Research and Rehabilitation Center
Marine Mammal Protected Areas Task Force: Marine Mammal Protected Areas Task Force (IMMA)
Институт океанологии РАН — оценки уровня: Shirshov Institute of Oceanology RAS — Caspian level estimates
Институт океанологии им. П.П. Ширшова РА: P.P. Shirshov Institute of Oceanology, RAS
Публикации по хвостохранилищу Кошкар-Ата: Publications on the Koshkar-Ata tailings pond
Научные публикации, отчёты акимата Манги: Scientific publications, reports of the Mangystau regional administration
NCOC — авиаучёты каспийского тюленя: NCOC — aerial surveys of the Caspian seal
Отраслевые отчёты по запасам и добыче уг: Industry reports on hydrocarbon reserves and production
